d: Descending deep into the massive Batagay permafrost crater, the search focuses on securing viable, intact Woolly Mammoth DNA preserved inside the ancient ice. Battling sub-zero conditions and treacherous terrain, Josh navigates this prehistoric landscape to extract frozen bone marrow and soft tissue specimens untouched for thousands of years. Uncovering these biological remnants could unlock long-lost secrets of ice-age giants and challenge what science knows about extinction.
